description:
Something is very wrong here. This CD is part of a 4-CD-Album, which itself is part of a 120+ Album-collection. This CD is CD 4 of Album 37 - according to the songs. But the album Artists are Duke Ellington, Woody Herman, Stan Kenton and Shorty Rogers. PMDA seems to add these four to all songs, even though on this particular CD only Shorty Rogers is the disc artist. See for comparison the respective musicbrainz entry: https://musicbrainz.org/release/288ae526-fffd-4a76-b52b-5b72b8a22e0f

There is also no way to properly match this disc, as PMDA seems to compare only entire albums, and the other 3 CDs are missing. Which makes sense, because they are being shown as different entries.
